notes: 6.7.1: fixes Word translation sending embedded-image base64 to the model as if it were text. Some editors export a .docx with the whole image written into a drawing's alt-text attribute as a data:image/...;base64,... URI — not body text, so the 6.7 base64 skip never caught it. One real document held 8 of them: ~515k tokens translated for nothing. They are now skipped at extraction (that file: 2,077,000 -> 39,924 characters, 1848 -> 433 batches), while genuine alt text is still translated. / 6.7.1：修复 Word 翻译把内嵌图片的 base64 当正文送去翻译。有些编辑器导出的 docx 会把整张图以 data:image/...;base64,... 写进图片替代文字属性，它不在正文里，6.7 的 base64 跳过没拦住。实测一份文档里有 8 条这种数据、约 51.5 万 tokens 白烧；现在抽取阶段就跳过（该文档 207 万字符→4 万，切分 1848 批→433 批），真正的替代文字照常翻译。
